purpose: broaden known-DEV input coverage, expose algorithm/data/scale limits, and obtain matched method evidence without selecting for favorable runtime

planning_scope.deliverable_only: two prospective planning artifacts in deliverables; no repository edits or runnable manifest

selection.basis: prior DEV exposure and deterministic input-coverage strata; not outcome-blind and not a representative sample
selection.membership_rule: Reserve the repeatedly studied control ODs OD00/OD02/OD06/OD10 and failure sentinel OD07. From remaining original OD IDs in ascending order take the first six, selecting their original high-SOC scheduled query. Add original low-SOC scheduled OD06 and OD07 as two failure sentinels. Retain both original N32 and N128 domains for every query.
selection.new_OD_meaning: additional to the repeatedly used current control program, not never previously executed; all belong to the original exposed 48-query DEV slate
selection.method_order: flat then hier for every domain; descriptive fixed-order timing limitation retained
selection.diagnostic_stratum_not_population_sample: OD06/OD07 were deliberately retained because of known preparation failures. They are regression/accounting sentinels. An unchanged deterministic seed policy can repeat known failure; that is expected diagnostic evidence, not a fresh algorithmic coverage success.

input_identity.hash_policy: all digests copied from existing metadata; this planning pass computes no real-data hash and independently rechecks no file digest
input_identity.hierarchy_policy: retain original hierarchy identifiers/topology, empty/unary regions and multi-site leaves while intersecting membership with each original frozen candidate list
input_identity.original_binding_policy: each domain copies the original complete binding and ordered pool prefix verbatim; no sorting, repair, expansion, new windows or candidate reselection
input_identity.original_and_runtime_identity_policy: Keep original query/site/anchor/candidate/sparse-domain hashes distinct from newly authenticated live runtime-domain hashes after common-seed/Hmax admission; never overwrite the original metadata identity or call original hash strings independent runtime authentication.

algorithm_intent.new_generic_runner_required: the existing scheduled gate admits OD06 N128 only; it is not implicitly generalized by this plan. Generalized binding, authentication, lifecycle and unsupported-case handling need focused validation and independent prelaunch review before a separate freeze

common_seed_and_depth.policy: one fresh original physical-proposal preparation per original query/N domain; independently authenticate and replay the common seed before either method; both methods use exactly that seed and its admitted Hmax
common_seed_and_depth.unknown_Hmax_policy: use the unchanged reviewed seed-to-depth rule; record the fresh common seed and derived Hmax before either search. If a historical admitted expected Hmax is separately established, declare it before launch and require equality. Do not derive a depth from later improved incumbents
common_seed_and_depth.no_seed_policy: retain preparation failure/seed_exhausted_unknown; keep both search rows and both replay descendants as blocked/skipped in denominator; do not claim candidate-domain/global infeasibility

sentinel_context.status: historical zero-proposal seed exhaustion supported additively; old controller_error and permit_next=false remain
historical completed heuristic stream with zero proposals; both exact methods undispatched; feasibility remains unknown

common_seed_and_depth.OD07_original_candidate_coverage_limit: The known original candidate-coverage limitation is retained; the separately demonstrated 128+21=149 portable reachable-candidate domain is a different problem domain. Repeating the unchanged original seed policy can deterministically exhaust again. No implied repair is part of this batch.
common_seed_and_depth.runtime_query_binding: Record each freshly admitted runtime query/domain and Hmax separately from original H_ref=4 payloads; both methods must bind to the same common seed/depth/domain.

existing_gate_reference.qualification: keep linked gate report separate; include in descriptive 16-domain coverage grid only after source/configuration/input/budget equivalence is authenticated; a mismatch remains unqualified, never replaced silently

denominators.conditional_speed_ratio_denominator: number of matched domains with both authenticated exact outcomes, each with its own successful fresh replay; display this count / 15 for incremental batch and separately count / 16 for qualified linked coverage grid

high_SOC_scheduled_new_OD.interpretation: new matched input-coverage opportunity, not presumed completion

low_SOC_scheduled_seed_failure_sentinel.interpretation: outcome-informed diagnostic regression; report separately, never use failures/successes as a representative population estimate

budget_proposal.budget_reason: 1200 matches the currently running original OD06 N128 comparison and supplies one common finite exact-search allowance for every selected domain; it is a prospective extension of historical 600-second rows, not a replacement or selected-case increase
budget_proposal.historical_48_CPU_hour_accounting: remains unreconciled; show existing known subtotals and this separately scoped future reservation, never claim a reconciled lifetime total from them. Before launch declare an enforceable incremental aggregate-charge ceiling and its measurement method; do not label process soft limits as aggregate enforcement
budget_proposal.incremental_ceiling_status: proposal only; measurement and enforcement need to be declared in the future execution manifest; no claim that process limits enforce it or that historical lifetime 48h is reconciled

resource_policy.before_each_heavy_launch: read actual MemAvailable; missing/malformed data or below floor blocks launch and retains slot. Observation is not a reservation

optional_N32_only_future_scheduler.required_evidence: complete uncensored process-tree peaks from both methods and relevant stages of representative serial N32 scheduled domains, plus actual host total/current available memory and successful cleanup; prior N32 process-only peaks or N128 estimates cannot substitute
optional_N32_only_future_scheduler.formula: 2 * 1.25 * P32 + 2 GiB <= actual measured MemTotal, and MemAvailable >= 1.25 * P32 + 2 GiB before an additional worker
optional_N32_only_future_scheduler.P32_policy: maximum complete observed process-tree RSS across the explicitly reviewed N32 scheduling class and its relevant stages; class-specific scheduling is a new proposal and cannot silently relax the existing global-P rule
optional_N32_only_future_scheduler.known_N32_3_10_GiB_context: even treating earlier 3.10 GiB as P yields 9.75 GiB including reserve, above nominal 9.73 GiB; no current two-worker admission is supported
optional_N32_only_future_scheduler.loss_of_memory_telemetry_pressure_or_unk: disable future concurrent starts, preserve failed slots, never terminate unrelated processes

acceptance_and_accounting.per_method_exact_completion: authenticated canonical exact terminal outcome and full key/proper unattained semantics plus fresh full independent physical replay, healthy final observer, counters and owned cleanup
acceptance_and_accounting.matched_comparison: same original query/N, common seed/Hmax, production algorithm, features, cache limits, source/runtime/compiler policy and budgets; explicit FLAT singleton and HIER region adapters
acceptance_and_accounting.canonical_disagreement: stop affected comparisons immediately; classify correctness blocker; retain all evidence
report_per_domain: seed availability and exact derived Hmax
final or last authenticated feasible charging-stop count
certified minimum charge-count lower bound or unknown
candidate count and ordered input identity
acceptance_and_accounting.CPU_and_wall_accounting: report physical shared preparation once in batch totals; charge its entire wall cost to each standalone method. Separate online setup/search, global preprocessing, independent replay and controller overhead. Do not add nested inclusive timers, split invocation CPU into invented per-method worker CPU, or sum cumulative host snapshots
acceptance_and_accounting.rates: all 30 incremental search rows and 15 paired domains stay in denominators, including failed preparation descendants; show 75 operational slots. Qualified linked gate is separately disclosed for 32-row/16-domain/80-slot coverage totals
acceptance_and_accounting.statistics: descriptive small purposive cohort; group by OD, not repeated timings as independent observations; no outcome-based exclusion or generalization/causal hierarchy speedup claim
stop_conditions: declared incremental aggregate-charge allowance exhausted; unstarted slots remain blocked, never replaced
acceptance_and_accounting.staged_denominators: Report A and B separately and the complete design denominator. Unadmitted/unstarted rows are planned/not-launched, not runtime failures or successful solves. Retain them in design/operational coverage reporting; do not imply a 30-row executed completion rate if only stage A runs.

known_domain_limits: All selected inputs are already exposed original DEV. No independent holdout, geographic generalization or public deployment claim follows.
N32/N128 are nested truncated candidate domains, not proof of full-universe optimality or candidate sufficiency.
The original six prespecified full-universe checks remain a separate bounded obligation/evidence scope; this plan adds no full-universe solve gate.
No case is assumed seed-feasible, exact-completable, or to require multiple charges. Observed multi-charge feasible/optimal witnesses and certified necessary charge-count bounds are distinct.

The target of 12 independently supported multi-charge queries in the original 48 is assessed honestly; failure to meet it is a data limitation, not permission to alter batteries, delete simple cases, or choose winners.
Fixed order, shared host and OS/cache effects limit timing interpretation; matched bound families do not make queue order, region aggregation or pruning identical.
Historical 192 rows, fixed24 infrastructure-unknown row, prior seed failures, resource-accounting gaps and namespace-cleanup unknowns stay visible.
Existing limited reduction/coalescing, cold/warm and bounded transportation baseline evidence is not reopened as a full factorial requirement.

main.phase_caveat: Serial rows without reached_phase remain unknown; do not classify all timeouts as pre-search.

fixed_supplement.memory_scope: 8 GiB per-process address space only; no cgroup or aggregate RSS enforcement

prelaunch_requirements: Review this prospective selection and retain it before any new selected-case outcome; existing pending OD06 gate membership is unconditional and historical exposure is explicit.

Implement and independently validate only the needed generic method-aware runner/binding/admission/lifecycle support on tiny data; do not claim the OD06-only gate already supports all selected domains.

Separately freeze clean source closure, production identity, exact policy/configuration, original input identity, deterministic seed-to-depth policy, finite budget and lifecycle result schema; keep optional candidates excluded.
Declare the incremental aggregate-charge allowance and measurement/stop method; disclose historical accounting uncertainty and maintain safe serial launch preflights.
Do not view, select, hash or execute any final holdout input.

execution_stages.purpose: first bounded new input-coverage tranche; run all four N32 domains in listed order, then all four N128 domains, without outcome-based promotion
remaining two new-OD high-SOC queries plus the two outcome-informed failure-sentinel queries; existing OD06 N128 gate is linked once, never duplicated

execution_decision: No automatic launch. Root decides whether and when to admit stage A, then stage B, after the current matched pair. This is one prospective eight-query design; all unstarted planned slots stay explicitly planned/not-launched. Neither 30 new rows nor the full 32-row coverage grid is a mandatory taskbook acceptance gate.

runtime_inputs.storage: external generated input directory supplied to the experiment
runtime_inputs.pool_binding: canonical SHA-256 of complete ordered prefix and ordered candidate IDs; sorted candidate hash is separately retained
runtime_inputs.missing_input_policy: fail; never synthesize or download implicitly; generate/restore exact bound inputs before launch
